common.disclaimer: Historical analysis for education only. Not investment advice.
common.loadError: The data could not be loaded right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
common.notFoundBody: The page you asked for does not exist or has moved.

home.metaTitle: analysisACE: Shariah screening and macro analytics for the DSE
home.title: See why a DSE stock passes or fails a Shariah screen
home.subtitle: analysisACE is building open, explained Shariah screening and macro analytics for the Dhaka Stock Exchange, with household finance tools for Bangladesh.

shariah.title: Shariah screen with reasons
shariah.body: Every listed company tested against published rules, shown with the company's own figures and the report they came from.

macro.title: Rates and shocks
macro.body: How each stock has historically moved when treasury bill yields changed, and how it behaved in past crises.

household.title: Household finance
household.body: Daily costs, Zakat, tax figures, net worth across shares, sukuk, deposits, gold and land, and FIRE planning.

companies.title: Companies
companies.intro: Companies listed on the Dhaka Stock Exchange.
companies.name: Name
companies.count: {count, plural, =0 {No companies} one {# company} other {# companies}}
companies.showing: Showing the first {shown} of {total}. Search to narrow the list.
companies.empty: No company data has been loaded yet.

company.noPrice: No price data has been loaded for this company yet.
company.shariahPending: The Shariah screen for this company has not been published yet.

auth.signInIntro: Welcome back. Sign in to your analysisACE account.
auth.signUpIntro: Free to join. You can delete your account at any time.
auth.acceptTerms: I agree that analysisACE may store my account details to provide this service.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. The link works for about an hour.
auth.resetIntro: You will be signed out on all devices.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.

account.title: My account
account.passwordIntro: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
account.consentsIntro: You can change these at any time. Each change is recorded with its date.

MARKETING.title: Product news by email
MARKETING.body: Occasional emails about new features. No third-party marketing.

RELIGIOUS_PREFERENCES.title: Zakat and Shariah preferences
RELIGIOUS_PREFERENCES.body: Lets analysisACE store religious preferences, such as your Zakat method and nisab basis. This is sensitive data and is used only for those features.

COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKING.title: Anonymous community comparisons
COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKING.body: Includes your figures in anonymised group averages. Nothing that identifies you is shown.

account.dataIntro: Download a copy of everything analysisACE holds about you.
account.deleteIntro: Deletes your account and all data tied to it straight away. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirmBody: Enter your password to confirm. Your account and data will be removed permanently.

admin.usersIntro: Change a person's role or turn their access off. Every change is written to the audit log.
admin.count: {count, plural, =0 {No users} one {# user} other {# users}}
admin.rolesIntro: Roles are fixed. This table shows what each role may do.

USER.name: User
USER.description: Every registered person. Uses the public and personal features.

ANALYST.name: Analyst
ANALYST.description: Staff who review data and publish content.

ADMIN.name: Administrator
ADMIN.description: Full control, including users and rule files.

DATA_REVIEW.name: Review data
DATA_REVIEW.description: Work the data review queue and correct extracted financial figures.

CONTENT_PUBLISH.name: Publish content
CONTENT_PUBLISH.description: Publish weekly macro notes and shock events.

SHARIAH_OVERRIDE.name: Override Shariah status
SHARIAH_OVERRIDE.description: Add Shariah board notes and manual overrides with a reason.

CONFIG_MANAGE.name: Manage rules
CONFIG_MANAGE.description: Approve rule file versions and bank flags.

USERS_MANAGE.name: Manage users
USERS_MANAGE.description: See all users, change roles and turn access on or off.

AUDIT_VIEW.name: View audit log
AUDIT_VIEW.description: Read the record of admin actions.

errors.UNKNOWN_TICKER: That DSE ticker is not known.

owners.title: Who owns it
owners.hint: Leave empty if it belongs to you alone. Shares must add up to 100%.

chart.showTable: Show the numbers as a table

overview.intro: Everything your household owns and owes, valued today, from the records you keep here.
overview.byMemberIntro: Shared assets and debts are split by each owner's share.
overview.historyIntro: Stored once a day by the daily job, or when you record it now.
overview.historyEmpty: The chart appears once two days have been stored.

costs.intro: Record what the household spends. Totals and the inflation view are worked out for you.
costs.realHint: The last column restates each month in {month} prices using the BBS consumer price index.
costs.recurringIntro: Rent, school fees and other fixed costs are added on their due dates automatically.
costs.categoriesIntro: The standard categories are always there. Add your own if you need more.
costs.importIntro: A CSV with the columns date, amount, category and note. The category is its name or key.

portfolio.intro: Your accounts and what is in them. Listed shares are valued at the latest DSE close; everything else at the value you enter.
portfolio.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Add one below.
portfolio.deleteAccountBody: The account and everything in it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
portfolio.addAccountIntro: A BO account, a bank, a savings certificate book, a provident fund and so on.
portfolio.numberHint: Stored encrypted. Only the last digits are shown.
portfolio.importIntro: The portfolio statement from your broker, saved as CSV. Quantities and costs replace what the BO account holds.
portfolio.addHoldingIntro: A share, a fund, a sukuk, a deposit or cash. Enter the total you paid.
portfolio.tickerHint: For listed shares and funds only.
portfolio.currentValueHint: Leave empty for listed shares; their value comes from the DSE close.
portfolio.finalRateHint: For Mudaraba products: the rate the bank finally declared.
portfolio.interestBearingHint: Marks conventional interest so the Zakat and Shariah views can show it.
portfolio.liabilitiesIntro: Loans and money owed. The part due within a year is used for Zakat.
portfolio.dueWithinYearHint: Instalments due in the next 12 months.
portfolio.transactionsIntro: Purchases, sales, profit and dividends. They are used to work out returns.
portfolio.unitsHint: For a purchase or sale of shares or units.

assets.intro: Land, flats, gold, business stakes, private loans and other assets that are not in an account.
assets.xirrHint: From the cost, cash flows and latest value.
assets.tbillHint: To set a promised return against. Auction of {date}.
assets.addIntro: Gold and silver are valued from their weight and the day's price; everything else from the value you enter.
assets.currentValueHint: Leave empty for gold and silver.
assets.revalueEvery: Remind me to update the value every
assets.recoverableHint: For money lent: a loan you expect back counts towards Zakat.
assets.ddTitle: Questions to ask about a private deal
assets.ddIntro: Your answers are kept with the asset. They are not scored or rated.

dd.counterparty_known: I know the other party personally
dd.exit_terms_written: How to get the money back is in writing

assets.ddPromisedHint: Compare it with the T-bill yield above.
assets.deleteBody: The asset, its values, cash flows and documents will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
assets.valuationsIntro: The newest value is used for net worth.
assets.cashFlowsIntro: Rent, profit share, instalments and money added.
assets.documentsIntro: Deeds, agreements and receipts. Stored encrypted and only ever downloaded.

sukuk.intro: Your sukuk and Islamic deposits, coming dates, and published rates beside the T-bill yield and inflation. Information only.
sukuk.holdingsIntro: Profit so far at the stated rate. A Mudaraba rate stays provisional until the bank declares the final one.
sukuk.noHoldings: No sukuk or Islamic deposits recorded.
sukuk.profitAtRate: Profit to date at this rate
sukuk.calendarIntro: Maturities of your holdings and upcoming government sukuk auctions.
sukuk.bankSafetyIntro: How your deposits are spread, with any public notice about a bank.
sukuk.compareIntro: Expected rates as each bank states them, with the rate above inflation and the gap to the T-bill yield.

performance.intro: How your listed and recorded investments have done in the past, beside the DSE indices. It describes the past and does not predict.
performance.twrHint: Leaves out the effect of money added or taken out.
performance.xirrHint: Your own return, including when you added money.
performance.volatilityHint: How much the value moved up and down.
performance.drawdownHint: From a high to the following low.
performance.chartIntro: Each line starts at 100, so your portfolio and the indices can be compared on one scale.

allocation.intro: How your money is spread, and how far it has drifted from the mix you chose.
allocation.byShariahHint: From analysisACE's own screening and your own labels.
allocation.bySectorHint: Shares of the listed part only.
allocation.driftIntro: The gap between the mix you hold and the mix you set. A class outside its band is marked.
allocation.noTargets: Set a target mix below to see drift.
allocation.setTargetsIntro: Targets must add up to 100%. The band is how far a type may drift before it is marked. Leave a type empty to leave it out.

zakat.intro: Work out Zakat for one person on a date, line by line, from the household's records.
zakat.provisional: The Zakat rules here are provisional until a Shariah advisor approves them. Check the result with a scholar you trust.
zakat.consentBody: Zakat uses religious preferences, which we only keep with your consent. Turn on "Zakat and Shariah preferences" in your account.
zakat.newIntro: Leave the optional fields empty to use the person's own settings and the stored metal price.
zakat.nisabHint: Gold or silver, as your scholar advises.
zakat.pricePerGramHint: Leave empty to use the stored price for the date.
zakat.deductionsIntro: Debts due within a year, at this person's share.
zakat.linesIntro: Each asset at this person's share, how it is treated and what counts.

tax.intro: A wealth statement and income summary for a tax year, to help fill in the return. It is not a tax return.
tax.notAdvice: Check figures and rebate rules with a tax adviser before filing. The rebate list is provisional.
tax.newIntro: Profit, dividends and rent are taken from your records. Add salary and other income here.
tax.deductedIntro: Tax taken at source by banks and issuers.
tax.rebateEligible: Purchases that may qualify for rebate
tax.assetsIntro: At this person's share, at cost as the return asks.

fire.intro: See when your savings could cover your costs, using your own assumptions. A projection, not a forecast.
fire.noPlans: No plans yet. Start one below.
fire.newIntro: The starting values come from your records. Change any of them before you project.
fire.includeIlliquid: Include property and other illiquid assets
fire.illiquidIncluded: Illiquid assets are included in the starting net worth.
fire.illiquidExcluded: {amount} of property and other illiquid assets is left out of the starting net worth.
fire.yearlyExpensesHint: Your last 12 months of recorded costs.
fire.inflationHint: Average CPI inflation over the last {months} months.
fire.withdrawalHint: The share of savings spent each year.
fire.planIntro: In today's taka, from the inputs below.
fire.projectionIntro: Year by year in today's taka. The dashed line is the FIRE number.
fire.scenariosIntro: Test the plan against a market fall, the replay of a past event, higher costs, stopping work earlier or higher inflation.
fire.scenarioAge: Reached at {age} ({change} years later than the plan)
fire.eventHint: The DSEX fall after it is applied to your listed shares.
fire.noEvents: No events in the library yet.
fire.paramHint: Leave empty for the usual size.

goals.intro: Targets for net worth, money invested or FIRE age, and how close you are.
goals.onTrack: on track at the current pace
goals.addIntro: Give a target amount, or a target age for a FIRE goal.
goals.targetAmountHint: For net worth and invested-amount goals.

alerts.intro: Notices about your money, and how you want to receive them. Until an email provider is set up, emails are not sent.
alerts.settingsIntro: Each alert also shows here in the app.

describe.ALLOCATION_DRIFT: When an asset type moves outside the band you set.
describe.VOLATILITY: When your listed holdings move more than your limit.
describe.MATURITY_DUE: Before a holding matures, and before a government sukuk auction.
describe.REVALUATION_DUE: When a property or other asset needs a new value.
describe.MONTHLY_REPORT: A summary at the start of each month.

notice.ALLOCATION_DRIFT: {asset_class} is {actual_pct}% of your portfolio. Your target is {target_pct}% with a band of {band_pct} points.
notice.VOLATILITY: Over the past year your listed holdings moved with an annualised volatility of {volatility_pct}%. Your limit is {limit_pct}%.
notice.SUKUK_AUCTION: {name} is scheduled for auction on {date} ({days} days from now).
notice.REVALUATION_DUE: {name} was last valued more than {months} months ago. Enter its current value to keep your net worth up to date.
notice.HAWL_APPROACHING: The Zakat date for {name} is {date} ({days} days from now).

community.intro: See how your savings rate and FIRE progress compare with people of a similar age. Anonymous and opt-in.
community.consentBody: Turn on "Anonymous community comparisons" in your account. Only anonymous medians are shown, and only for groups large enough that no one can be picked out.
community.noPlan: The comparison uses your newest FIRE plan. Make one first.
community.noBand: Your age is outside the groups
community.tooSmall: The group comparison appears once at least {n} people of your age band have joined.

household.intro: The people whose money you track together, and what each may do.
household.createIntro: A household holds your accounts, assets and costs. You can add family members later.
household.name: Household name
household.membersIntro: Owners manage members. Editors add and change records. Viewers only look.
household.hawlHint: The day each year Zakat falls due (hawl).
household.addIntro: Add a child or a relative without a login, or share with someone who already has an analysisACE account.
household.emailHint: Only to share with an existing account.
household.anotherIntro: For example, your parents' money kept separately. Switch between households at the top of each page.

returnBasis.OWN_SUKUK_AND_DEPOSITS: From the rates of your own sukuk and deposits
